# Format of `config/rota.yaml`

<!-- GENERATED by taxidermist from taxonomy/. Do not hand-edit: edit the schema and run `taxidermist docs`. -->

A list, one item per entry, each with the fields below.

## Copy this

```yaml
- week: <str>
  team: <str>
  person: <str>
```

## What to put in each field

**`week`** · required · `str` · matches `^\d{4}-W\d{2}$`  
The ISO week, as `2026-W27`.

**`team`** · required · `str`  
The team on call that week.

Values: any top-level key of [`config/teams.yaml`](../../config/teams.yaml). Checked, so a name that is not one is a fault.

**`person`** · required · `str`  
The person page slug of whoever answers.

Values: any page under [`people/`](../../people/), by its filename without `.md`. Checked, so a name that resolves to no page is a fault.

## Adding a value

A field's `definitions` keys **are** its allowed values, so a value cannot exist until someone writes down what it means. Prefer an existing one, because a near-synonym fragments every filter. If nothing fits, add it to the right file under [taxonomy/](../README.md) with its one line, in the same change that uses it. `taxidermist check` fails otherwise.
